##: 模板：platforms/windows/packaging/render.py 按一个 windows-v 发布填写 @...@ 字段；放进 bucket 之后由 checkver 与 autoupdate 跟上新版本。
不是便携应用：输入法要在系统范围注册 TSF DLL 与 COM 类，所以这里运行发布的 Inno Setup 安装包（按机器安装，会弹 UAC），Scoop 的应用目录里什么也不留。安装包就地升级并保留数据目录，所以卸载脚本在 scoop update 时什么也不做，只在 scoop uninstall 时运行 Inno 卸载程序，后者也会删除安装包拥有的数据目录。
description: Metasequoia IME (水杉输入法): Chinese input method for Windows. Not related to Microsoft IME.
notes: Metasequoia IME was installed machine-wide by its own installer (Program Files\metasequoiaime), not into the Scoop directory.
It needs the Visual C++ 2015-2022 x64 redistributable and the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime; the installer only logs which one is missing when it runs silently.
'scoop uninstall msime' also deletes the input method's data directory (your own words, settings and skins).

script: if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "Metasequoia IME installer exited with $($process.ExitCode)" }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $key)) { warn 'Metasequoia IME is not installed; nothing to uninstall.'; return }
if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "Metasequoia IME uninstaller exited with $($process.ExitCode)" }
# The Inno uninstaller relaunches itself from a temporary copy and returns at once; wait for it to remove its own file.
